serviceMechanism.fact: Service option falls back to getenv(PGSERVICE). Only NULL means no service. Present empty string is not NULL and is not bypassed.
PGSERVICEFILE=/dev/null is selected because its environment variable is present. Empty file yields no matching service section.
If no system service section exists either, emit definition of service "" not found and return3.
Any parseServiceInfo error with real error buffer stops conninfo_add_defaults.
conninfo_array_parse returns NULL when default processing fails.
PQconnectStartParams returns CONNECTION_BAD at813-817 before pqConnectDBStart at843. No PostgreSQL FATAL or SQL row is required for this frontend failure.

boundary: This establishes the deterministic failure mechanism under the stated empty-service environment and absent service definitions. The first failed command discarded stderr, so its exact emitted error text is not retrospectively recovered by this review. Root/E retain the actual failure/closure evidence separately.
requiredServiceCorrection: Do not set PGSERVICE at all in the new container when pinned helper image Config.Env has no PGSERVICE. Omitting service from a connstring does not override an existing empty environment service. Preserve explicit Unix socket/port/user/database.

additionalPassfileHazard.fact: Without an explicitly supplied password, libpq tries passwordFromFile. PGPASSFILE=/dev/null passes stat but fails S_ISREG, so libpq writes a warning to stderr. V1 runner requires empty stderr even on exit0; leaving this assignment can consume the last attempt with a predictable rejection.
additionalPassfileHazard.recommendedMinimalCorrection: Also omit PGPASSFILE when helper image has no PGPASSFILE and fresh HOME=/layout has no .pgpass. Default missing file is silently ignored at7453-7455. No credential, query or security gate changes required.
additionalPassfileHazard.freshHomeGuard: Before the sole psql invocation, disk contains only new pgdata and socket; .pgpass must not exist. Native HOME is fixed /layout.

failureProofCorrection: Capture nonzero command exit via exception carrying already capped stdout/stderr buffers; preserve both exact buffers and exit code before final FAIL receipt. Also save sole psql out/err immediately on exit0 before stderr/JSON acceptance, so warnings remain inspectable. Existing byte/time/resource limits remain.
oldFailure: FAIL remains FAIL. It proves no layout result and is not reclassified as PASS.
